{
  "pattern_id": "P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE",
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "rationale": "The workflow uses a large matrix of Ruby versions, Gemfiles, and databases, which results in many redundant dependency installations. Implementing `actions/cache@v4` for the Bundler cache (keyed by the specific Gemfile and Ruby version) can reduce the time spent in `bundle install` across the matrix. Although `ruby/setup-ruby` with `bundler-cache: true` already provides some caching, adding an explicit cache step or ensuring the existing mechanism is optimized for the matrix is the goal. Since `setup-ruby` is already present, I will add a dedicated `actions/cache` step to explicitly manage the Bundler path to ensure the distributed cache pattern is implemented as requested, even though `setup-ruby` is a high-level abstraction of this.",
  "workflow_yaml": "on:
  push: null
  pull_request: null
  workflow_dispatch: null

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.ruby == 'head' || matrix.gemfile == 'gemfiles/activerecord_edge.gemfile' }}
    env:
      DB: ${{ matrix.db }}
      BUNDLE_GEMFILE: ${{ matrix.gemfile }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        ruby:
          - '4.0'
          - 3.4
          - 3.3
        gemfile:
          - gemfiles/activerecord_edge.gemfile
          - gemfiles/activerecord_8.1.gemfile
          - gemfiles/activerecord_8.0.gemfile
        db:
          - mysql
          - postgresql
          - sqlite3
        include:
          - ruby: truffleruby-head
            db: postgresql
            gemfile: gemfiles/activerecord_8.0.gemfile

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:10
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: acts_as_taggable_on
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
        ports: ['5432:5432']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      mysql:
        image: mysql:8
        env:
          MYSQL_ALLOW_EMPTY_PASSWORD: true
        ports: ['3306:3306']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "mysqladmin ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Set up Ruby
      uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
      with:
        ruby-version: ${{ matrix.ruby }}
        bundler-cache: true
    - name: Cache Bundler dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: vendor/bundle
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-gems-${{ matrix.ruby }}-${{ matrix.gemfile }}-${{ hashFiles(matrix.gemfile) }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-gems-${{ matrix.ruby }}-${{ matrix.gemfile }}-\
          ${{ runner.os }}-gems-${{ matrix.ruby }}-\
          ${{ runner.os }}-gems-
    - name: Create MySQL test database with utf8mb4 charset
      if: ${{ matrix.db == 'mysql' }}
      run: |
        mysql -uroot --host=127.0.0.1 -e "CREATE DATABASE acts_as_taggable_on CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci"
    - name: Build and test with Rake
      run: |
        bundle exec rake
"
}
